I answered Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store is Pine Crossing.

That comes from her own Jun 9 message in #central-team. She wrote that the morning receiver at Pine Crossing saw only the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. Hollis replied that he'd check the shift template and have support test it with the store login.

That conversation names the store but gives no street address, city or site code. I didn't find one in anything else she can see either, so I told her to check the store address sheet or ask Hollis before she puts a full location in the account sheet.
